Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_14565",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
    "line":203,"var":"tga.colormap_length","code":"const int size = 3 * tga.colormap_length;",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input-controlled colormap_length (value 1) determines how many palette bytes are read, leaving palette[3..767] uninitialized"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
    "line":204,"var":"palette","code":"const int dataRead = s.readRawData(palette, size);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Only 3 bytes are read into the 768-byte stack palette array"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
    "line":208,"var":"palette","code":"memset(&palette[dataRead], 0, size - dataRead);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Memset only zeroes up to size (3) bytes, not the full 768-byte palette; palette[3..767] remain uninitialized"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
    "line":279,"var":"idx","code":"uchar idx = *src++;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Pixel index value 255 is read from image buffer (input-controlled)"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
    "line":280,"var":"palette[3 * idx + 2]","code":"scanline[x] = qRgb(palette[3 * idx + 2], palette[3 * idx + 1], palette[3 * idx + 0]);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Reads palette[765..767] which are uninitialized stack memory (use-of-uninitialized-value)"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",

     "line":280,"operands":["palette[3 * idx + 2]","palette[3 * idx + 1]","palette[3 * idx + 0]"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"3 * idx","right":"size"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
       "line":203,"operands":["tga.colormap_length"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
       "line":208,"operands":["size"]},
      "type":"data","via":["size"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"size","right":"3 * tga.colormap_length"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/imageformats/tga.cpp","function":"LoadTGA",
       "line":208,"operands":["palette"]},
